# proficiency interval

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:proficiencyInterval`](gmeow-proficiencyInterval.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/proficiencyInterval>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/languages`](../../slices/languages.md)
